rules.name: cs-refresh-cache-cfs-verify-uat
rules.sql: SELECT c.value_date, v.value_date AS valuation_date, count(*) AS cache_rows, max(c.created_timestamp) AS built, CASE WHEN c.value_date = v.value_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS on_valuation_date, CASE WHEN max(c.created_timestamp) > now() - interval '1 hour' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS built_last_hour FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = c.business_unit WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY c.value_date, v.value_date

expect.reason: one value date in the CFS cache
the cache is on the CFS valuation date
